name: CRM
description: Company CRM: one company table from lead to client (CSV and Apollo import with domain and email dedupe, cited web research, System 1-picked outreach, follow-ups DM'd to the salesperson on their cadence); one Activities timeline of PIC messages from WhatsApp, email, Telegram, Slack and Discord filtered by System 1, with images and voice notes read into each job's requirements and decisions; a configurable template catalogue of documents, outreach emails and research prompts rendered to PDF; meeting recording with transcription and minutes; two-way Google Calendar.
description_zh: 公司客户关系管理：从线索到客户的一张公司表（CSV 与 Apollo 导入，按域名和邮箱去重）、带出处的网络调研、自动挑选的外联与按销售节奏推送的跟进；来自 WhatsApp、邮件、Telegram、Slack 和 Discord 的联系人消息汇成一条活动时间线，图片和语音读入每个项目的需求与决定；可配置的文档、外联邮件与调研提示模板目录并生成 PDF；会议录音转写与纪要；与 Google 日历双向同步。
